title: Woman Impersonates A Detective And Quickly Goes Away In Cuffs
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On April 6th, 2023. Officers attempted to conduct a traffic stop on a woman however she tried to flee the scene. After reaching an intersection she was then cornered in by police. She refused to leave her car after being instructed to do so multiple times. After Police forced her out of the car she said the reason she couldn’t get out was because she was doing detective work and couldn’t believe that they were real police.
 This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
